headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to review legal immigration rules and support efforts to help new immigrants settle in and become citizens.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to look at how the legal immigration system works and to strengthen programs that help immigrants become part of American communities. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Immigrants going through the legal immigration process
who_it_affects.how: The rules and procedures they deal with may be reviewed and possibly changed by federal agencies.

who_it_affects.group: Lawful permanent residents (green card holders) seeking citizenship
who_it_affects.how: Efforts to support integration and inclusion may affect programs that help them settle in and become citizens.
They are directed to review and work on legal immigration and integration efforts.
